items.q: There was a dentist there that sounded like Marshall Royal on lead alto.

ctx.x: Yeah. Easier to find out who you haven’t — when you were 17 let’s say, did you have those kinds of aspirations, to just be —

Since I was like a senior or a junior in high school. You know I was having so much fun in music. I did everything I could. Like I was in high school, and there was a local group of musicians, The Doctor’s Band, and they met like once every two weeks or so. Dentists, lawyers, some of them had gone out with territory bands, and some of them were great. There was a dentist there that sounded like Marshall Royal on lead alto. His name was Dr. Culshack. He laid that down man. And these guys took me in, and I just had…
Were you fortunate to have a good teacher in the public school?
